_README: Extra rooms that get a COPY of an account's SETUP messages, keyed by the account the setup is about. Read by algos/shared/notify.py per message, so an edit here reaches a running bot with no restart. It NEVER changes where a message's own room is - accounts.json still decides that, and this only adds a destination.
_SETUPS_ONLY: Setups, never fills and never machinery. A setup is an opinion about where price is; a fill is somebody's money, and a live account's trades room borrows nothing and is copied nowhere - that rule is the reason each account names its own rooms at all. The kind is checked in the code, so a trades room written here would still never receive anything.
_WHY_ITS_OWN_FILE: Not a field on an account's row in accounts.json, because the Command Center REPLACES a row when somebody edits that account on the page and keeps only the _-prefixed prose keys. A field the page does not know about would be dropped the next time anyone touched the account, silently. Nothing but notify.py reads this file and nothing but a person writes it.
_IT_NEEDS_A_PROMOTE: The data arrives on the box with a pull, but the code that reads it is frozen into each bot's deployed snapshot (algos/shared is in ORDER_PATH_ROOTS). A bot promoted before 2026-09-23 sends no copies until its next promote.
_HOW_TO_TEST_A_ROOM: From C:\trading on the box: python algos/tools/verify_channel.py --chat-id <id> --kind signal. The bot can only post to a chat it has been added to.
_OFF_ON_PURPOSE: 34957946 -> -1004314325555 was enabled and then switched OFF the same day, 2026-09-23, and the reason is worth keeping. The room turned out to be MPC Signals, a channel the user's STUDENTS read, not a second private room - and a setup message carries its LOT SIZE and dollar risk (see notes/telegram-and-notifications.md -> THE RESTING MESSAGE CARRIES ITS LOT SIZE). Copying it verbatim would publish one owner's live position sizing, and his balance by arithmetic, to a class. A student feed needs its OWN render with every account-derived number removed - prices, R and the rule names are safe, lots and dollars are not. Until that exists this stays empty, and the copy path itself is unchanged and tested.
_HOW_TO_TURN_IT_ON_FOR_A_PRIVATE_ROOM: "copies": { "<account>": ["<chat id>"] } - fine for a room only the owners read, which is what it was built for.
